name: AriaOS Neural Core & Local LLM Studio Manager
description: Manage local LLM weights (aria-core, qwen2.5, deepseek-coder), benchmark CPU/GPU inference speed, and inspect/edit AriaOS persistent neural memory.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List installed and recommended local AI models, active model profile, and neural memory statistics.

tools.name: benchmark_inference
tools.description: Run a fast local CPU/RAM neural inference benchmark and estimate tokens/second capacity.

tools.name: switch_active_model
tools.description: Switch AriaOS active local LLM model (e.g. aria-core, qwen2.5:0.5b, qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, llama3.2:1b).

tools.name: inspect_neural_memory
tools.description: Inspect or add custom learned aliases and user preferences in AriaOS persistent neural memory.
